summary: Snowmobiler suffered a suspected broken leg in a remote area of Rabbit Ears Pass. RCSAR was paged and requested Classic Air Medical; the helicopter located the snowmobile party from the air, dropped paramedics to assess the patient, and ferried two RCSAR team members with skis and rescue equipment from a staging area at Dumont Lake. A ground team of four RCSAR members and a Steamboat Springs Fire Rescue medic snowmobiled in with a toboggan, used a rope system to lower the patient down a steep slope, then transported him by toboggan to the waiting helicopter, which flew him to the hospital. RCSAR escorted the remaining snowmobilers back to the trailhead.
location: Rabbit Ears Pass, near Dumont Lake
responding_agency: Routt County Search and Rescue; Classic Air Medical; Steamboat Springs Fire Rescue
